name: Our Purpose
overview: Scripture reveals that our purpose is divinely ordained and sovereignly directed by God, who forms and calls each person for His glory and specific intentions. Though human plans may guide our steps, it is the LORD who ultimately directs them and establishes His purposes, which cannot be overturned. Our chief duty, as the conclusion of all matters, is to fear God and keep His commandments, fulfilling the purpose for which He created and sanctified us even before our birth.
